spark.name: Spark
spark.summary: Enemy stack takes 10 + 5 × Power direct damage.
spark.lore: The first thing every apprentice learns: a crack of light between two fingers, thrown hard. Masters never stop using it.

blessing.name: Blessing
blessing.summary: Ally rolls its maximum damage through the current and next round.
blessing.lore: A priest touches a spear-point and names a god. For a little while every blow lands as if aimed by that god’s own hand.

ward.name: Ward
ward.summary: Ally +3 Defense through the current and next round.
ward.lore: A circle drawn in the air around a company. Patron gods grant it to those who keep their oaths.

warcry.name: War Cry
warcry.summary: Ally +3 Attack through the current and next round.
warcry.lore: A shout that is half prayer, half threat. Soldiers who hear it remember why they came.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.summary: Enemy stack takes 25 + 10 × Power direct damage.
lightning.lore: The sky-father’s weapon, borrowed for one stroke. Those who ask too often find the sky stops answering.

mend.name: Mend
mend.summary: Heal up to 20 + 5 × Power of the front creature’s missing HP; no resurrection.
mend.lore: Field-surgeons’ magic, plain and practical: flesh remembers being whole and is persuaded to be so again.

veil.name: Veil
veil.summary: Ally takes ×0.75 damage from ranged strikes through the current and next round.
veil.lore: A shimmer in the air like heat over stones. Arrows lose their way in it.

divine_sight.name: Divine Sight
divine_sight.summary: Adventure only: reveal radius 3 around a known tile until next dawn.
divine_sight.lore: Gods see the whole world at once. For a single night, they lend a hero a corner of that view.

swiftness.name: Swiftness
swiftness.summary: Ally +2 Speed through the current and next round.
swiftness.lore: Spoken over a soldier’s feet, it makes the ground feel like a downhill road.

weariness.name: Weariness
weariness.summary: Enemy −2 Speed through the current and next round (never below 1).
weariness.lore: Every soldier knows the hour before dawn when the shield gets heavy. This spell brings that hour early.

fleet_foot.name: Fleet Foot
fleet_foot.summary: Adventure only: the caster gains 200 movement points today.
fleet_foot.lore: Couriers’ magic: the day stretches a little longer for whoever carries urgent news.

homecoming.name: Homecoming
homecoming.summary: Adventure only: the caster returns to the nearest town you own; its movement ends for the day.
homecoming.lore: Every hearth remembers the one who left it. The spell lets that memory pull the hero home.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.summary: Every friendly stack +2 Defense through the current and next round.
aegis.lore: The goatskin shield of the sky-father, lent to his daughter of wisdom. Its shadow over an army turns aside every second blow.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.summary: Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 20 + 8 × Power damage.
thunderclap.lore: The noise of the king of the gods losing his temper. Anyone close enough to hear it is close enough to be hurt.

berserkergang.name: Berserkergang
berserkergang.summary: Every friendly stack +2 Attack through the current and next round.
berserkergang.lore: Bear-shirted warriors who bite their shields and feel no wounds. The spell spreads their madness through the ranks — briefly.

frost_breath.name: Frost Breath
frost_breath.summary: Enemy −3 Speed through the current and next round (never below 1).
frost_breath.lore: The breath of the frost giants, who were here before the gods. Joints stiffen, feet freeze to the ground.

scarab_swarm.name: Scarab Swarm
scarab_swarm.summary: Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 15 + 6 × Power damage.
scarab_swarm.lore: The scarab rolls the sun across the sky. When angered, a thousand of them roll over whatever stands in the way.

eye_of_horus.name: Eye of Horus
eye_of_horus.summary: Adventure only: reveal radius 5 around a known tile until next dawn.
eye_of_horus.lore: The falcon god lost an eye fighting for his father’s throne; it was healed and became a charm of seeing.

divine_wind.name: Divine Wind
divine_wind.summary: Every friendly stack +2 Speed through the current and next round.
divine_wind.lore: A wind sent by the gods once scattered an invading fleet. Called over an army, it pushes every soldier forward.

blossom_veil.name: Blossom Veil
blossom_veil.summary: Ally +5 Defense through the current and next round.
blossom_veil.lore: Cherry blossoms fall for only a few days. While they fall, nothing sharp seems to reach the one they cover.

glamour.name: Glamour
glamour.summary: Enemy −3 Attack through the current and next round.
glamour.lore: The Fair Folk’s favourite trick: make a sword look like a stick, a captain like a fool. The enemy forgets how to fight.

wild_hunt.name: Wild Hunt
wild_hunt.summary: Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 25 + 9 × Power damage.
wild_hunt.lore: Hounds, horns and riders out of the storm. Whatever the Hunt passes over is never quite the same.

obsidian_rain.name: Obsidian Rain
obsidian_rain.summary: Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 15 + 7 × Power damage.
obsidian_rain.lore: Volcanic glass falls like hail from a sky the colour of smoke. Priests say the mountain is only returning what was taken from it.

fifth_sun.name: Fifth Sun
fifth_sun.summary: Every friendly stack +3 Attack through the current round.
fifth_sun.lore: Four suns have died and the fifth is kept alive by sacrifice. For one round, every warrior burns with its light.

ill_omen.name: Ill Omen
ill_omen.summary: Enemy stack rolls its minimum damage through the current and next round (a Blessing on it cancels out).
ill_omen.lore: Every army has a soldier who sees a crow on the left and loses heart. The spell finds that soldier in every rank at once and makes him right.

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.summary: Ally takes ×0.8 damage from melee strikes through the current and next round.
shield_of_faith.lore: Priests of every road-shrine teach the same prayer: not for victory, only that the next blow land a little lighter. Soldiers say it under their breath before the lines meet.

hearthlight.name: Hearthlight
hearthlight.summary: Heal up to 12 + 4 × Power of the front creature’s missing HP; no resurrection.
hearthlight.lore: A glow like the fire of home, carried into the field. Wounds close a little, as they do when a mother is near.

far_sight.name: Far Sight
far_sight.summary: Adventure only: reveal radius 2 around a known tile until next dawn.
far_sight.lore: Shepherds’ magic: look at a hill long enough and you can see what grazes on its far side.

ember_burst.name: Ember Burst
ember_burst.summary: Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 12 + 5 × Power damage.
ember_burst.lore: A handful of coals from the forge, thrown with a word. Smiths invented it to keep thieves from their yards; captains made it a weapon.

sapping_touch.name: Sapping Touch
sapping_touch.summary: Enemy −3 Attack through the current and next round.
sapping_touch.lore: The fever-healer’s art turned backwards: instead of drawing sickness out, it pours weariness in.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.summary: Ally +4 Defense through the current and next round.
steadfast.lore: Old sergeants call it the stubborn spell. It does not make soldiers braver, only harder to move.

clear_skies.name: Clear Skies
clear_skies.summary: Adventure only: reveal radius 4 around a known tile until next dawn.
clear_skies.lore: Sailors pay well for it: one day without fog, and a whole valley laid out like a map.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.summary: Every enemy stack takes 10 + 4 × Power damage.
starfall.lore: On the night the old gods quarrelled, stars fell on both their armies. Astronomers learned to ask for a few more — but only over the enemy.

rallying_hymn.name: Rallying Hymn
rallying_hymn.summary: Every friendly stack +3 Defense through the current round.
rallying_hymn.lore: Every people has a song it sings when the line is about to break. The spell lets the whole army hear it at once.

leaden_air.name: Leaden Air
leaden_air.summary: Every enemy stack −1 Speed through the current and next round (never below 1).
leaden_air.lore: The air over the enemy turns thick as summer before a storm. Horses balk; even birds fly low.

renewal.name: Renewal
renewal.summary: The front creature of every friendly stack heals up to 10 + 5 × Power HP (no resurrection).
renewal.lore: Springtime, called down for a moment over a battlefield. It cannot bring back the dead, but it remembers the living.

hoplon_wall.name: Hoplon Wall
hoplon_wall.summary: Ally takes ×0.75 damage from melee strikes through the current and next round.
hoplon_wall.lore: Each round shield covers the neighbour’s left side; the line stands or falls together. The spell locks the shields edge to edge as if one smith had forged them all.

apollos_arrow.name: Apollo’s Arrow
apollos_arrow.summary: Enemy stack takes 20 + 8 × Power direct damage.
apollos_arrow.lore: The far-shooting god’s arrows brought plague to the proud and light to the faithful. His priests ask only for one arrow, and aim it themselves.

wings_of_hermes.name: Wings of Hermes
wings_of_hermes.summary: Adventure only: the caster gains 150 movement points today.
wings_of_hermes.lore: The messenger of the gods never walked when he could run, and never ran when he could fly. Heralds who honour him find the road shorter.

rune_of_tyr.name: Rune of Tyr
rune_of_tyr.summary: Ally +4 Attack through the current round.
rune_of_tyr.lore: Tyr gave his hand to bind the wolf. Warriors cut his arrow-rune on their blades and ask him for one honest stroke.

norns_thread.name: The Norns’ Thread
norns_thread.summary: Enemy stack rolls its minimum damage through the current and next round.
norns_thread.lore: At the root of the world-tree three women spin every life. A völva who knows the right song can make them shorten one thread — for a little while.

gjallarhorn.name: Gjallarhorn
gjallarhorn.summary: Every enemy stack −2 Attack through the current and next round.
gjallarhorn.lore: Heimdall will blow the horn once, at the end of all things. Its echo, called up by a skald, is enough to make an enemy feel that the end has come.

ankh_of_renewal.name: Ankh of Renewal
ankh_of_renewal.summary: Heal up to 15 + 5 × Power of the front creature’s missing HP; no resurrection.
ankh_of_renewal.lore: The key of life, held to a wound. Temple healers say the ankh does not heal — it only reminds the body what it was.

wrath_of_sekhmet.name: Wrath of Sekhmet
wrath_of_sekhmet.summary: Enemy stack takes 22 + 9 × Power direct damage.
wrath_of_sekhmet.lore: The lioness once nearly devoured mankind and was calmed only with red beer. Her priests can still wake a little of that rage — and point it.

balance_of_maat.name: Balance of Ma’at
balance_of_maat.summary: The front creature of every friendly stack heals up to 12 + 6 × Power HP (no resurrection).
balance_of_maat.lore: On the scale of judgement a heart is weighed against a feather. Ma’at restores what was taken unjustly — and in battle, much is.

kitsune_fire.name: Kitsune-bi
kitsune_fire.summary: Enemy stack takes 12 + 5 × Power direct damage.
kitsune_fire.lore: Fox-fire drifts over the rice paddies on autumn nights. Travellers who follow it are lost; enemies who are followed by it burn.

yata_mirror.name: Mirror of Yata
yata_mirror.summary: Ally takes ×0.5 damage from ranged strikes through the current and next round.
yata_mirror.lore: A mirror once drew the sun goddess out of her cave. Its reflection, cast over a company, turns arrows aside like light from polished bronze.

raijin_drums.name: Raijin’s Drums
raijin_drums.summary: Every enemy stack takes 12 + 5 × Power damage.
raijin_drums.lore: The thunder god beats a ring of drums across the sky. When his shrine-maidens dance, he sometimes beats them over the enemy’s camp.

bramble_snare.name: Bramble Snare
bramble_snare.summary: Enemy −2 Speed through the current round (never below 1).
bramble_snare.lore: Hawthorn is the fairies’ tree; cut it and it takes revenge. The druids simply ask it to reach for the enemy’s ankles.

cauldron_of_dagda.name: Cauldron of the Dagda
cauldron_of_dagda.summary: Heal up to 25 + 6 × Power of the front creature’s missing HP; no resurrection.
cauldron_of_dagda.lore: No one ever left the Dagda’s cauldron hungry. A ladle of its broth, summoned to the field, mends what hunger and steel have opened.

mist_of_manannan.name: Mist of Manannán
mist_of_manannan.summary: Every enemy stack −2 Speed through the current and next round (never below 1).
mist_of_manannan.lore: The sea god hides his islands behind a cloak of mist. Druids borrow a corner of it, and the enemy marches in circles.

jaguar_spirit.name: Jaguar Spirit
jaguar_spirit.summary: Ally +4 Attack through the current round.
jaguar_spirit.lore: The jaguar hunts by night and by surprise. Warriors who wear its pelt call its spirit into their arms for one leap.

smoking_mirror.name: Smoking Mirror
smoking_mirror.summary: Enemy −4 Attack through the current and next round.
smoking_mirror.lore: Tezcatlipoca’s obsidian mirror shows each man his own death. Those who glimpse it fight like men already beaten.

rain_of_tlaloc.name: Rain of Tlaloc
rain_of_tlaloc.summary: The front creature of every friendly stack heals up to 8 + 4 × Power HP (no resurrection).
rain_of_tlaloc.lore: The rain god keeps four jars: one waters the maize, the others bring frost, drought and blight. His priests pray only for the first.

warding_token.name: Warding Token
warding_token.summary: +1 commander Defense. A token recovered from the centaur cache.
warding_token.lore: A clay token stamped with a centaur’s hoof, found in a cache in the hills. Shepherds say it keeps wolves — and arrows — away.

bronze_standard.name: Bronze Standard
bronze_standard.lore: A bronze eagle on an ash pole. Where it stands, the line stands.

winged_sandals.name: Winged Sandals
winged_sandals.lore: Sandals with small wings at the heel, of the kind the messenger god wears. These are a mortal smith’s copy, and almost as good.

bronze_spear.name: Bronze Spear
bronze_spear.lore: An honest spear of ash and bronze, the weapon of every citizen soldier.

storm_iron_blade.name: Storm-iron Blade
storm_iron_blade.lore: Forged from iron that fell from the sky in a thunderstorm. It hums before a battle.

linen_cuirass.name: Linen Cuirass
linen_cuirass.lore: Layers of linen glued and stitched until they are as stiff as wood. Cheaper than bronze and cooler in summer.

scale_hauberk.name: Scale Hauberk
scale_hauberk.lore: Overlapping bronze scales on a leather shirt, like the skin of a river serpent.

seers_circlet.name: Seer’s Circlet
seers_circlet.lore: A thin silver band worn by oracles, who see further with their eyes closed.

crown_of_counsel.name: Crown of Counsel
crown_of_counsel.lore: A crown given to a queen who never made a decision without hearing the poorest of her people first.

knucklebone_charm.name: Knucklebone Charm
knucklebone_charm.lore: Five sheep knucklebones from a game soldiers play in camp. Someone always wins; whoever carries these wins more often.

band_of_insight.name: Band of Insight
band_of_insight.lore: A ring of plain iron, engraved inside with “Know yourself.”

watchers_ring.name: Watcher’s Ring
watchers_ring.lore: A ring set with a stone like an eye. The night watch passes it from sentry to sentry.

swift_saddle.name: Swift Saddle
swift_saddle.lore: A light saddle of the steppe riders, who are born in the saddle and never quite leave it.

phalanx_spear.name: Phalanx Spear
phalanx_spear.summary: +2 commander Attack. Panoply of the Phalanx.
phalanx_spear.lore: Long, heavy, and meant to be held with a hundred others pointing the same way.

phalanx_aspis.name: Phalanx Aspis
phalanx_aspis.summary: +2 commander Defense. Panoply of the Phalanx.
phalanx_aspis.lore: A great round shield, carried on the left arm to cover the neighbour as much as oneself.

phalanx_helm.name: Crested Helm
phalanx_helm.summary: +1 commander Defense. Panoply of the Phalanx.
phalanx_helm.lore: A bronze helm with a horsehair crest that makes a man look a head taller in the front rank.

sun_diadem.name: Sun Diadem
sun_diadem.summary: +2 commander Spell Power. Regalia of the Sun King.
sun_diadem.lore: A diadem of gold rays, worn by a priest-king who was the sun’s representative on earth.

sun_scepter.name: Sun Scepter
sun_scepter.summary: +1 commander Spell Power and +1 Knowledge. Regalia of the Sun King.
sun_scepter.lore: A gold rod topped with a sun-disc. The priest-king pointed it, and the kingdom moved.

sun_signet.name: Sun Signet
sun_signet.summary: +2 commander Knowledge. Regalia of the Sun King.
sun_signet.lore: The priest-king’s seal: a sun pressed into wax made any order law.

wayfarer_boots.name: Wayfarer’s Boots
wayfarer_boots.lore: Boots resoled so many times that nothing of the first pair remains — except, perhaps, the luck.

wayfarer_cloak.name: Wayfarer’s Cloak
wayfarer_cloak.summary: +1 commander Defense and +1 hex of vision. Wayfarer’s Kit.
wayfarer_cloak.lore: A heavy travelling cloak with deep pockets and a hood that keeps out rain from any direction.

wayfarer_compass.name: Star Compass
wayfarer_compass.summary: +2 hexes of adventure vision. Wayfarer’s Kit.
wayfarer_compass.lore: A needle that points not north but toward the nearest place worth seeing.

champion_blade.name: Champion’s Blade
champion_blade.summary: +2 commander Attack. Relics of the Fallen Champion.
champion_blade.lore: The sword of a champion whose name is lost. It still remembers every duel.

champion_torc.name: Champion’s Torc
champion_torc.summary: +1 Luck for the army. Relics of the Fallen Champion.
champion_torc.lore: A champion’s gold neck-ring, worn smooth by years of fighting.

champion_banner.name: Champion’s Banner
champion_banner.summary: +1 morale for the army. Relics of the Fallen Champion.
champion_banner.lore: A tattered banner whose emblem has faded. Soldiers still know what it means.

boar_crest_helm.name: Boar-crested Helm
boar_crest_helm.lore: A bronze boar rides the crest, bristles raised. Northern smiths believed the boar watched over a sleeping warrior and woke him before an ambush.

cap_of_darkness.name: Cap of Darkness
cap_of_darkness.summary: +2 hexes of adventure vision and +1 Luck.
cap_of_darkness.lore: Made by the Cyclopes for the lord of the dead, it hides its wearer from every eye. A hero who wears it sees much and is seldom seen.

nemes_of_ra.name: Nemes of Ra
nemes_of_ra.lore: The striped headcloth of kings, gold and lapis for the sun and the night sky. Whoever wears it speaks with the authority of both.

dragon_kabuto.name: Dragon Kabuto
dragon_kabuto.lore: A lacquered helmet with a gilded dragon between its horns. It was made for a general who never once turned his back on a battle.

mistletoe_crown.name: Mistletoe Crown
mistletoe_crown.lore: Cut from an oak with a golden sickle on the sixth night of the moon. Druids wear it when they must remember everything at once.

quetzal_war_crown.name: Quetzal War Crown
quetzal_war_crown.lore: Green plumes of the sacred bird, worth more than gold. A captain who wears them is seen from across the battlefield — that is the point.

brisingamen_link.name: Link of Brísingamen
brisingamen_link.lore: One link of the necklace four dwarves made for the goddess of love and war. It still glows faintly, like a hearth seen through snow.

heart_scarab.name: Heart Scarab
heart_scarab.lore: A green stone beetle laid over the heart of the dead, inscribed: “Do not stand against me.” The living wear it so their courage does not testify against them.

magatama_string.name: String of Magatama
magatama_string.summary: +1 Luck and +1 hex of adventure vision.
magatama_string.lore: Curved jewels like claws or crescent moons, strung on silk. They were offered to the sun goddess when the world went dark.

torc_of_the_high_king.name: Torc of the High King
torc_of_the_high_king.lore: A twisted gold collar no one may wear who has run from a fight. The warband knows the rule; seeing it on their leader steadies them.

jade_pectoral.name: Jade Pectoral
jade_pectoral.lore: Green jade is the breath of life. Priest-kings wore a carved plaque over the heart to keep their spirit strong in the presence of gods.

wanderers_grey_cloak.name: Wanderer’s Grey Cloak
wanderers_grey_cloak.summary: +2 hexes of vision and +5% daily land movement.
wanderers_grey_cloak.lore: A broad-brimmed traveller in a grey cloak asks for a seat by every fire and listens more than he speaks. Some say he leaves his cloak behind for those who listen too.

nemean_lionskin.name: Nemean Lionskin
nemean_lionskin.lore: No blade could cut the lion of Nemea; the hero strangled it and flayed it with its own claws. The pelt still turns steel.

raven_feather_cloak.name: Raven-feather Cloak
raven_feather_cloak.lore: The battle-crow goddess flies over every field before the fighting. A cloak of her feathers makes the road feel like flight.

jaguar_pelt_cape.name: Jaguar-pelt Cape
jaguar_pelt_cape.lore: Only a warrior who has taken four captives may wear the jaguar. Young soldiers fight harder near one, hoping to earn their own.

harpe_of_perseus.name: Harpe of Perseus
harpe_of_perseus.lore: A sickle-sword given by the god of messengers, sharp enough to take the head of a monster whose gaze turned men to stone.

rune_marked_sword.name: Rune-marked Sword
rune_marked_sword.lore: Its maker hammered his name into the blade in letters no other smith could read. It bends, springs back and never breaks.

khopesh_of_set.name: Khopesh of Set
khopesh_of_set.lore: A hooked bronze blade of the red desert’s god — storm, strength and confusion. It strikes from angles a shield does not expect.

storm_gods_tachi.name: Storm God’s Tachi
storm_gods_tachi.summary: +2 commander Attack, +1 Defense and +1 Luck. Unique.
storm_gods_tachi.lore: The storm god found it in the tail of the eight-headed serpent he had slain. It is said to part grass like wind and fire like water.

spear_of_lugh.name: Spear of Lugh
spear_of_lugh.lore: One of four treasures the gods brought to Ireland. No battle was ever won against the one who held it.

obsidian_macuahuitl.name: Obsidian Macuahuitl
obsidian_macuahuitl.lore: A wooden war-club edged with blades of volcanic glass sharper than any steel. Each blade is a fragment of the smoking mirror.

polished_bronze_shield.name: Polished Bronze Shield
polished_bronze_shield.summary: +2 commander Defense and +1 hex of vision.
polished_bronze_shield.lore: Polished until it was a mirror, so its bearer could look at what must not be looked at. Scouts use it to see around corners.

shieldmaiden_round_shield.name: Shieldmaiden’s Round Shield
shieldmaiden_round_shield.summary: +1 commander Defense; tier 1–2 creatures +1 Defense in battle.
shieldmaiden_round_shield.lore: Painted linden-wood with an iron boss. Shieldmaidens held the front of the wall so the young warriors behind them could learn.

shield_of_the_medjay.name: Shield of the Medjay
shield_of_the_medjay.lore: Cowhide over a wooden frame, carried by the desert scouts who policed the tombs of kings. Light enough to run with, strong enough to stop a spear.

fianna_targe.name: Targe of the Fianna
fianna_targe.lore: No one joined the war-band of the Fianna until they had stood in a pit with only a shield and a hazel stick, and nine warriors had cast spears at them.

eagle_chimalli.name: Eagle Chimalli
eagle_chimalli.lore: A round shield faced with eagle feathers and a gold rim. The eagle fights the sun’s enemies every dawn; its warriors fight the empire’s.

bronze_buckler.name: Bronze Buckler
bronze_buckler.lore: A small fist-shield sold in every market from the harbours to the mountains. Not glorious, but often enough.

iron_shod_spear.name: Iron-shod Spear
iron_shod_spear.lore: Ash shaft, iron point, a smith’s mark on the socket. The first weapon of every militia and the last one a veteran gives up.

boiled_leather_jerkin.name: Boiled-leather Jerkin
boiled_leather_jerkin.lore: Ox-hide boiled in wax until it is hard as wood. It turns a glancing blade and costs a week’s wages.

waxed_travel_cloak.name: Waxed Travel Cloak
waxed_travel_cloak.lore: Wool rubbed with beeswax so the rain runs off. A dry rider rides longer.

copper_circlet.name: Copper Circlet
copper_circlet.lore: A plain band hammered from one sheet of copper. Students wear it to keep their hair — and, they say, their thoughts — in place.

clay_votive_amulet.name: Clay Votive Amulet
clay_votive_amulet.lore: A thumb-sized figure of the household god, fired in a potter’s kiln and blessed at the town shrine. Soldiers touch it before every charge.

watchmans_lantern.name: Watchman’s Lantern
watchmans_lantern.lore: A horn-paned lantern with a hood that throws its light forward. Night watches see farther, and so does the hero who carries one.

scholars_oil_lamp.name: Scholar’s Oil Lamp
scholars_oil_lamp.lore: A small clay lamp for reading at night. A spellcaster who studies by it wakes with one more charm remembered.

bronze_seal_ring.name: Bronze Seal Ring
bronze_seal_ring.lore: A signet cut with a spiral. Pressed into wax it seals a letter; pressed into a palm before a spell, its owner swears, it seals the spell tighter.

woven_saddle_blanket.name: Woven Saddle Blanket
woven_saddle_blanket.lore: Thick wool in the colours of the weaver’s village. A horse that does not chafe walks an extra hour.

einherjar_mail.name: Mail of the Einherjar
einherjar_mail.lore: The chosen dead fight every day in the hall of the slain and are whole again by evening. Their mail mends with them.

lacquered_oyoroi.name: Lacquered Ō-yoroi
lacquered_oyoroi.lore: Hundreds of lacquered scales laced with silk in the colours of a house. Soldiers recognise the colours across a field and stand firmer.

quilted_cotton_armor.name: Quilted Cotton Armor
quilted_cotton_armor.lore: Two fingers of salt-hardened cotton, stitched tight. Conquerors from over the sea laughed at it, then traded their steel for it.

scarab_scale_corselet.name: Scarab-scale Corselet
scarab_scale_corselet.summary: +2 commander Defense and +1 mana at dawn.
scarab_scale_corselet.lore: Bronze scales shaped like beetles that roll the sun across the sky. The corselet is warm at dawn, as if it knows.

draupnir_echo.name: Echo of Draupnir
draupnir_echo.lore: Every ninth night the All-father’s ring drips eight rings as heavy as itself. This is one of those — and it remembers the trick, a little.

andvaris_ring.name: Andvari’s Ring
andvaris_ring.lore: The dwarf Andvari cursed the ring when it was taken from him: it would bring gold and ruin to all who owned it. Many have decided the gold is worth it.

signet_of_hermes.name: Signet of Hermes
signet_of_hermes.lore: A herald’s ring with a winged staff cut in carnelian. Gatekeepers wave its bearer through; roads seem to agree.

jade_ring_of_tlaloc.name: Jade Ring of Tlaloc
jade_ring_of_tlaloc.lore: Cool as rainwater even in the dry season. Priests wear it to keep their spirit from drying out during long fasts.

fairy_ring_band.name: Fairy-ring Band
fairy_ring_band.lore: Woven from grass taken from inside a ring of mushrooms at dawn. The Fair Folk are said to look kindly on whoever wears it — or at least to look elsewhere.

boots_of_the_long_road.name: Boots of the Long Road
boots_of_the_long_road.lore: Cobbled for a pilgrim who swore to visit every shrine of every god. He made it, they say, and the boots outlived him.

tengu_geta.name: Tengu Geta
tengu_geta.summary: +10% daily land movement and +1 hex of vision.
tengu_geta.lore: Tall one-toothed sandals of the mountain goblins, who taught swordsmanship to a boy in the forest. Wearers walk the ridges as if on a road.

scribes_papyrus_sandals.name: Scribe’s Papyrus Sandals
scribes_papyrus_sandals.summary: +1 commander Knowledge and +5% daily land movement.
scribes_papyrus_sandals.lore: Woven reed sandals of the temple scribes, who walked between the granaries counting everything. Light, quiet and quick.

skis_of_ullr.name: Skis of Ullr
skis_of_ullr.lore: The god of the hunt crosses the winter faster on his skis than a horse on summer roads. He lends them to anyone who swears by his ring.

sleipnir_horseshoe.name: Horseshoe of Sleipnir
sleipnir_horseshoe.lore: A shoe thrown by the eight-legged horse as it leapt the gate of the dead. Any mount that wears it forgets what tiredness was.

solar_chariot_harness.name: Solar Chariot Harness
solar_chariot_harness.lore: Gilded straps from the chariot of a king who drove into battle under the sun-disc. His soldiers followed the glint.

hippeis_barding.name: Barding of the Hippeis
hippeis_barding.summary: +1 commander Defense and +5% daily land movement.
hippeis_barding.lore: Bronze chest-plate for the horse of a cavalry noble. Expensive, heavy, and much admired at festivals.

wild_hunt_saddle.name: Saddle of the Wild Hunt
wild_hunt_saddle.summary: +10% daily land movement and +1 commander Attack.
wild_hunt_saddle.lore: On storm nights the Hunt rides across the sky. A saddle dropped from it still smells of rain and wants to gallop.

valkyries_horn.name: Valkyrie’s Horn
valkyries_horn.lore: The choosers of the slain drink from it before they ride. Warriors who hear it blown know they are being watched — and judged.

djed_amulet.name: Djed Amulet
djed_amulet.summary: After a won battle each stack regains 10% of its losses (floored).
djed_amulet.lore: The backbone of the god who died and rose again. Soldiers carry it so that what falls may stand up.

omamori_charm.name: Omamori Charm
omamori_charm.lore: A silk pouch from a shrine, holding a prayer no one may read. Opening it would let the luck out.

ogham_staves.name: Ogham Staves
ogham_staves.lore: Twenty letters cut as notches on yew staves, each a tree. Poets cast them to read fate and, when needed, to write it.

sun_stone_codex.name: Sun-stone Codex
sun_stone_codex.summary: +10% spell damage and +1 commander Spell Power.
sun_stone_codex.lore: A folding book of bark paper that counts the days of five suns. Its reader knows which hour belongs to which god.

lamp_of_prometheus.name: Lamp of Prometheus
lamp_of_prometheus.summary: +2 mana at dawn and +1 commander Spell Power.
lamp_of_prometheus.lore: A clay lamp lit, the story goes, from the coal the Titan stole for mankind. It has never gone out.

cornucopia.name: Cornucopia
cornucopia.summary: +200 Gold, +1 Wood and +1 Stone per day. Unique.
cornucopia.lore: The horn of the goat who nursed the king of the gods, broken off and filled forever. Armies that carry it never forage.

kibisis.name: Kibisis
kibisis.lore: The silver satchel that carried the monster’s head. Whatever goes into it — trophies, stories, lessons — comes out larger.

cauldron_of_plenty.name: Cauldron of Plenty
cauldron_of_plenty.summary: After a won battle each stack regains 10% of its losses; +1 morale. Unique.
cauldron_of_plenty.lore: The second treasure of the gods of Ireland. It fed every company that came to it, and none went away unsatisfied.

stone_of_fal.name: Stone of Fál
stone_of_fal.lore: The third treasure: a stone that roars when the rightful king steps upon it. A fragment of it hums under the hand of a true leader.

panoply_of_the_phalanx.name: Panoply of the Phalanx
panoply_of_the_phalanx.summary: Spear, shield and helm of a front-rank commander.

bonuses.summary: 3 pieces: every creature +2 Defense in battle

regalia_of_the_sun_king.name: Regalia of the Sun King
regalia_of_the_sun_king.summary: Crown, scepter and ring of a priest-king.

wayfarers_kit.name: Wayfarer’s Kit
wayfarers_kit.summary: Boots, cloak and compass of a tireless traveller.

bonuses.summary: 3 pieces: +300 Gold per day (trade on the road)

relics_of_the_fallen_champion.name: Relics of the Fallen Champion
relics_of_the_fallen_champion.summary: Blade, torc and banner of a champion whose name is forgotten.

bonuses.summary: 3 pieces: every creature +2 Attack in battle

gear_of_perseus.name: Gear of Perseus
gear_of_perseus.summary: Sickle-sword, mirror shield, cap of darkness and satchel of the hero who slew the Gorgon.

bonuses.summary: 4 pieces: flying creatures +2 Attack; +15% battle experience

arms_of_the_einherjar.name: Arms of the Einherjar
arms_of_the_einherjar.summary: Sword, shield, mail and horn of the warriors chosen for the hall of the slain.

bonuses.summary: 4 pieces: every creature +1 Attack and +1 Defense in battle

regalia_of_the_two_lands.name: Regalia of the Two Lands
regalia_of_the_two_lands.summary: Headcloth, blade and corselet of a king of the river and the desert.

bonuses.summary: 3 pieces: after a won battle each stack regains 10% of its losses

treasures_of_takamagahara.name: Treasures of Takamagahara
treasures_of_takamagahara.summary: Helmet, jewels and armour from the high plain of heaven.

bonuses.summary: 3 pieces: tier 1–4 creatures +1 Speed in battle

treasures_of_the_tuatha.name: Treasures of the Tuatha Dé
treasures_of_the_tuatha.summary: The spear, the cauldron and the stone the gods brought to Ireland.

bonuses.summary: 3 pieces: every creature +2 Defense in battle; +1 Luck

gifts_of_the_feathered_serpent.name: Gifts of the Feathered Serpent
gifts_of_the_feathered_serpent.summary: Crown, pectoral and shield blessed by the wind god who brought maize and books.

favorable_winds.name: Favorable Winds
favorable_winds.summary: Every hero of yours regains half a day’s movement.

bountiful_harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
bountiful_harvest.summary: The chosen town gains 4 recruits for every tier 1–3 creature family it houses.

inspiration.name: Inspiration
inspiration.summary: Every hero of yours regains 15 mana (never above its maximum).

rally_the_faithful.name: Rally the Faithful
rally_the_faithful.summary: Every friendly stack +2 Attack through the current and next round.

shield_of_the_gods.name: Shield of the Gods
shield_of_the_gods.summary: Every friendly stack +3 Defense through the current and next round.

mending_light.name: Mending Light
mending_light.summary: The front creature of every friendly stack heals up to 30 HP (no resurrection).

ride_of_the_valkyries.name: Ride of the Valkyries
ride_of_the_valkyries.summary: Every friendly stack +2 Speed through the current and next round.

blessing_of_the_nile.name: Blessing of the Nile
blessing_of_the_nile.summary: The chosen town gains 3 recruits for every tier 1–5 creature family it houses.

ward_of_the_kami.name: Ward of the Kami
ward_of_the_kami.summary: Every friendly stack +4 Defense through the current and next two rounds.

mists_of_the_sidhe.name: Mists of the Sídhe
mists_of_the_sidhe.summary: Every hero of yours regains a full day’s movement.

temple_treasury.name: Temple Treasury
temple_treasury.summary: The priests open the temple coffers: 2,000 Gold.

timber_and_stone.name: Timber and Stone
timber_and_stone.summary: Pilgrims haul offerings of building stuff: 5 Wood and 5 Stone.

tears_of_the_gods.name: Tears of the Gods
tears_of_the_gods.summary: Crystal forms where the god wept: 4 Crystal.

anointing.name: Anointing
anointing.summary: The hero visiting the town is anointed by the high priest: +1,000 experience.

blessed_brood.name: Blessed Brood
blessed_brood.summary: Every dwelling of tiers 1 to 4 in this town gains half a week of growth at once (at least 1).

temple_relic.name: Temple Relic
temple_relic.summary: The temple lends a relic from its vault to the hero visiting the town: a minor artifact.

zeus.name: Zeus
benefitSummary: Fixed patron of The Three Beacons.
No mechanical bonus is defined in rule profile pr-0.2-candidate.
zeus.quote: The storm answers to the one who keeps the lights.

Ward becomes learnable at a later Sanctum visit.

benefitSummary: +1 Attack for your commanders.

ares.quote: Break the force that bars the road.

apollo.name: Apollo
benefitSummary: +1 Spell Power for your commanders.
+1 morale for your armies.
apollo.quote: Sing before the battle, and the battle sings back.

artemis.name: Artemis
benefitSummary: Your shooters: +2 Attack in battle.
+1 hex of adventure vision for your heroes.
artemis.quote: Wait for the wind. Then loose.

hermes.name: Hermes

+250 Gold per day while you own a town.
hermes.quote: A road walked quickly is a road walked twice.

demeter.name: Demeter
benefitSummary: +2 weekly growth for every creature family of tiers 1–3 in your towns.
demeter.quote: Feed the valley and the valley will march for you.

hades.name: Hades

hades.quote: Not every shade has to stay below.

poseidon.name: Poseidon
benefitSummary: +10% land movement for your heroes.
Your tier 4–7 creatures: +1 Attack in battle.
poseidon.quote: The tide does not ask the shore.

hera.name: Hera
benefitSummary: +1 weekly growth for every creature family of tiers 1–4 in your towns.
+1 morale for your armies.
hera.quote: A city is a household. Keep it full.

norse_odin.name: Odin
benefitSummary: Patron of the Norse skirmish armies.

+2 hexes of adventure vision for your heroes.
norse_frigg.quote: I know how this ends. Walk where I point.

norse_baldr.name: Baldr

+2 mana for your heroes at every dawn.
norse_baldr.quote: Even the long night has a morning in it.

norse_freyja.name: Freyja
benefitSummary: +1 weekly growth for every creature family of tiers 1–5 in your towns.
norse_freyja.quote: Every hall fills again by spring.

norse_heimdall.name: Heimdall

All your creatures: +1 Defense in battle.
norse_heimdall.quote: I hear the grass grow. I heard you coming.

norse_hel.name: Hel
benefitSummary: After a battle you win, each stack regains 15% of its losses (rounded down; adds to other recovery).
norse_hel.quote: Half of what falls is mine. I may lend it back.

norse_loki.name: Loki
benefitSummary: +2 Luck for your armies.
+10% land movement for your heroes.
norse_loki.quote: Rules are for people who lose.

norse_njord.name: Njord
benefitSummary: +200 Gold per day while you own a town.
+1 Crystal per day while you own a town.
norse_njord.quote: Fair wind, full nets, heavy purses.

benefitSummary: Patron of the Egyptian skirmish armies.
No mechanical bonus in rule profile pr-0.2-candidate (mirrors Zeus; proposed).
egyptian_ra.quote: Each dawn I cross the sky; each dawn the city rises with me.

benefitSummary: +1 Attack for your commanders.
War Cry becomes learnable at a later House of Life visit.
egyptian_set.quote: Storms clear the ground for the strong.

egyptian_isis.name: Isis
benefitSummary: +1 Defense for your commanders.
Ward becomes learnable at a later House of Life visit.
egyptian_isis.quote: What is loved is put back together.

egyptian_anubis.name: Anubis

After a battle you win, each stack regains 10% of its losses (rounded down; adds to other recovery).
egyptian_anubis.quote: I weigh every heart. Yours may stay a while.

egyptian_bastet.name: Bastet
benefitSummary: +1 Luck for your armies.
Your tier 1–3 creatures: +1 Defense in battle.
egyptian_bastet.quote: Soft paws, sharp claws, a home well kept.

egyptian_osiris.name: Osiris
benefitSummary: After a battle you win, each stack regains 15% of its losses (rounded down; adds to other recovery).
egyptian_osiris.quote: I was scattered once. I know the way back.

egyptian_thoth.name: Thoth
benefitSummary: +1 Spell Power for your commanders.
+1 Knowledge for your commanders.
egyptian_thoth.quote: Write it down, and it is yours forever.

egyptian_horus.name: Horus
benefitSummary: Your flying creatures: +1 Attack in battle.
Your flying creatures: +1 Speed in battle.
egyptian_horus.quote: Whatever flies, flies for the throne.

egyptian_hathor.name: Hathor
benefitSummary: +250 Gold per day while you own a town.
+1 morale for your armies.
egyptian_hathor.quote: Music in the hall, gold in the treasury.

egyptian_sobek.name: Sobek
benefitSummary: +2 weekly growth for every creature family of tiers 1–3 in your towns.
+1 Stone per day while you own a town.
egyptian_sobek.quote: The flood takes, and the flood gives more.

japanese_amaterasu.name: Amaterasu
benefitSummary: Patron of the Japanese skirmish armies.
No mechanical bonus in rule profile pr-0.2-candidate (mirrors Zeus; proposed).
japanese_amaterasu.quote: Open the cave door, and the world is bright again.

provenance.note: Patron role mirrors Zeus; no bonus.

japanese_hachiman.name: Hachiman
benefitSummary: +1 Attack for your commanders.
War Cry becomes learnable at a later Onmyō Hall visit.
japanese_hachiman.quote: Draw the bow to its full length.

japanese_susanoo.name: Susanoo
benefitSummary: +1 Defense for your commanders.
Ward becomes learnable at a later Onmyō Hall visit.
japanese_susanoo.quote: The storm that breaks the wave also shelters the bay.

japanese_tsukuyomi.name: Tsukuyomi
benefitSummary: +1 Spell Power for your commanders.
+1 hex of adventure vision for your heroes.
japanese_tsukuyomi.quote: What the sun hides, the moon shows.

japanese_benzaiten.name: Benzaiten
benefitSummary: +1 Knowledge for your commanders.
+2 mana for your heroes at every dawn.
japanese_benzaiten.quote: Play one true note and the river answers.

japanese_inari.name: Inari
benefitSummary: +300 Gold per day while you own a town.
+1 Wood per day while you own a town.
japanese_inari.quote: Leave rice at the shrine; find more in the storehouse.

japanese_fujin.name: Fujin
benefitSummary: +20% land movement for your heroes.
japanese_fujin.quote: Open the bag. Let the road come to you.

japanese_raijin.name: Raijin
benefitSummary: +1 Spell Power for your commanders.
Your shooters: +2 Attack in battle.
japanese_raijin.quote: Every arrow carries a little of the storm.

japanese_izanagi.name: Izanagi
benefitSummary: +1 weekly growth for every creature family of tiers 1–4 in your towns.
+2 mana for your heroes at every dawn.
japanese_izanagi.quote: Stir the sea again; new islands will rise.

japanese_izanami.name: Izanami
benefitSummary: After a battle you win, each stack regains 20% of its losses (rounded down; adds to other recovery).
japanese_izanami.quote: Do not look back at me. Just come home.

celtic_dagda.name: Dagda
benefitSummary: Patron of the Celtic skirmish armies.
No mechanical bonus in rule profile pr-0.2-candidate (mirrors Zeus; proposed).
celtic_dagda.quote: The cauldron is never empty for those who share it.

provenance.note: Patron role mirrors Zeus; no bonus.

celtic_morrigan.name: Morrigan
benefitSummary: +1 Attack for your commanders.
War Cry becomes learnable at a later Druid Grove visit.
celtic_morrigan.quote: I have seen how this battle ends. Hurry.

celtic_brigid.name: Brigid
benefitSummary: +1 Defense for your commanders.
Ward becomes learnable at a later Druid Grove visit.
celtic_brigid.quote: Keep the fire lit and the door will hold.

celtic_nuada.name: Nuada
benefitSummary: +1 morale for your armies.
Your tier 4–7 creatures: +1 Defense in battle.
celtic_nuada.quote: A king stands in front. Stand with me.

celtic_danu.name: Danu
benefitSummary: +1 Spell Power for your commanders.
+1 weekly growth for every creature family of tiers 1–2 in your towns.
celtic_danu.quote: The land remembers every child it fed.

celtic_cernunnos.name: Cernunnos
benefitSummary: Your tier 1–3 creatures: +1 Attack in battle.
Your tier 1–3 creatures: +1 Defense in battle.
celtic_cernunnos.quote: The small ones of the wood are fiercer than they look.

celtic_epona.name: Epona
benefitSummary: +20% land movement for your heroes.
celtic_epona.quote: Saddle up. The long road is shorter with me.

celtic_lugh.name: Lugh
benefitSummary: +1 Luck for your armies.
+1 morale for your armies.
celtic_lugh.quote: Master one craft and I will teach you the rest.

celtic_arawn.quote: My hounds bring back what the field takes.

benefitSummary: +2 hexes of adventure vision for your heroes.
+15% land movement for your heroes.

mesoamerican_coatlicue.name: Coatlicue

+1 hex of adventure vision for your heroes.
mesoamerican_mixcoatl.quote: Follow the deer; the deer knows the way.

mesoamerican_xolotl.name: Xolotl

+10% land movement for your heroes.
mesoamerican_xolotl.quote: I have walked every road below. This one is short.

mesoamerican_tlaloc.name: Tlaloc
benefitSummary: +2 weekly growth for every creature family of tiers 1–3 in your towns.
mesoamerican_tlaloc.quote: The rain comes to those who remember it.

mesoamerican_tezcatlipoca.name: Tezcatlipoca
benefitSummary: +2 Luck for your armies.
mesoamerican_tezcatlipoca.quote: Look in the smoking mirror. See who wins.

mesoamerican_xiuhtecuhtli.name: Xiuhtecuhtli

mesoamerican_xiuhtecuhtli.quote: Feed the new fire, and it gives back more.

+1 weekly growth for every creature family of tiers 1–4 in your towns.
mesoamerican_chalchiuhtlicue.quote: The river washes the wound and fills the field.

benefitSummary: Your stacks at half strength or less: +2 Attack in battle (does not add to other fury).
+1 Luck for your armies.
mesoamerican_mictlantecuhtli.quote: The nearer to me, the harder they fight.

greek.name: Greek

signature.name: Glory
rules: Your heroes gain 25% more experience from battles they win (rounded down).

greek.summary: Disciplined hoplites, sky-borne griffins and the one-eyed giants of Thunder Quarry. The faction of The Three Beacons campaign; playable in skirmish too.

provenance.note: Roster provisionally reduced to one family per tier (Griffin at tier 3).

norse.name: Norse

signature.name: Berserk Fury
signature.summary: The fewer who stand, the harder they strike.
rules: In battle, a stack of yours with at most half of its starting creatures alive gains +2 Attack.

norse.summary: Barrow-risen Draugar, frost wolves, valkyries and the root-gnawing wyrms of the deep north. Playable in skirmish with proposed, unplaytested values.

provenance.note: Owner decision: Claude proposes every Norse number; labelled proposed.

egyptian.name: Egyptian
egyptian.summary: Sun-scarabs, jackal wardens, tireless ushabti and sphinxes of the river kingdoms. Playable in skirmish with proposed, unplaytested values.

signature.name: Afterlife
signature.summary: The fallen are called back from the west bank.
rules: After a battle you win, each of your stacks regains 20% of the creatures it lost in that battle (rounded down).
Never more than the stack lost; grants no experience, rewards or kills.

provenance.note: Owner request: every pantheon playable; Claude proposes every number; labelled proposed.

japanese.name: Japanese
japanese.summary: Fox spirits, river kappa, mountain tengu and the eight-headed Orochi of shrine and castle country. Playable in skirmish with proposed, unplaytested values.

signature.name: Harmony
rules: Counted when a battle starts: with 3 or more different creature families in your army, every stack gains +1 Defense.

provenance.note: Owner request: every pantheon playable; Claude proposes every number; labelled proposed.

celtic.name: Celtic
celtic.summary: Shape-shifting pooka, otherworld hounds, loch kelpies and the sea-giants of the hillforts. Playable in skirmish with proposed, unplaytested values.

signature.name: Shapeshifting
signature.summary: The old folk wear more than one skin.
rules: Creatures with Shapeshift (Pooka, Kelpie, Selkie, Horned Stag Spirit) change aspect at the start of their activation without spending it, once per activation.
Without this rite, Shapeshift spends the activation.

provenance.note: Owner request: every pantheon playable; Claude proposes every number; labelled proposed.

mesoamerican.name: Mesoamerican
mesoamerican.summary: Feathered serpents, jaguar spirits, eagle warriors and fire serpents of the temple cities. Playable in skirmish with proposed, unplaytested values.

signature.name: Offering
signature.summary: The sun is fed so that it rises.
rules: Once per week in each town with a Temple, offer creatures from the garrison or the visiting hero.
Gain 1 Favor per 125 Gold of their recruitment price (rounded down), at most 10 Favor per offering.
A hero cannot offer its last creature.

provenance.note: Owner request: every pantheon playable; Claude proposes every number; labelled proposed.
